_doc: Mutations for tools/impact/mutate.py (audit/ARCH-1_modules.md 8.4). run = the --cmd key that builds and runs the module's tests; expect_test = exe:test the impact map must list for the mutated diff. Add one per module as modules appear (ops, device, config), and one per fixed bug (re-introduce it with kind revert).

mutations.what: re-introduce today's bug: the diagnostic WHIRL_PREFIX_CACHE_VERIFY enters the SSD tier fingerprint
re-introduce today's bug: dedup skips a finished, not yet reaped base write (revert bf31527)
longest common prefix one short when one token list is a prefix of the other
supersede rule: near-end divergence (retry / edit) test inverted
restore verification (verifyPieces) never reports a mismatching piece
SSD block hash constant changed (files written by an older build no longer match)
one table slot resolved with the wrong export (hipGetDeviceCount bound to hipGetDevice)
load order reversed: the search path wins over the executable's folder
a broken runtime in the executable's folder silently falls back to another copy (no fixed order)
a HIP function missing from the runtime is ignored (null slot, crash at its first call)
NullBackend::copyAsync copies one byte short (a restore / spill copy loses its last byte)
fault injection: the pinned-host copy failure fires on device-sourced copies instead
